'''Shei Harsi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Holojournalist/Legends|reporter]] for the [[Imperial News Network (Imperial Remnant)|Imperial News Network]]. In [[44 ABY]], she covered the report on the [[Raid on Hagamoor 3|destruction]] of [[Natasi Daala]]'s&ndash;a candidate for the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Election of 44 ABY|election]]&ndash;campaign headquarters on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hagamoor 3]].<ref name="apocalypse" />
